Diagnostics & Service

Common Washing Machine Problems We Fix

Machine Not Spinning

Belt, motor, or lid switch issues diagnosed and repaired on-site.

Water Not Draining

Clogged pump, blocked hose, or faulty drain motor — we fix it fast.

Not Starting

Electrical faults, tripping issues, and control board repairs.

Leaking Water

Seal, hose, and tub leak repairs with genuine spare parts.

Excessive Noise

Drum bearing, suspension, and balance issue fixes.

PCB / Motherboard Repair

Display dead, random cycles, or buttons not responding — control board diagnosis, component-level repair or full board replacement.

Drum Bearing Replacement

Loud grinding or rumble on spin — drum bearing diagnosis and replacement with genuine parts.

Door Won't Open After Wash

Front load door lock and PCB signal issues — door released safely, lock mechanism replaced if needed.

  • Response Time: The stated 60–90 minute response time applies to service requests within our primary service areas and during working hours. Actual arrival time may vary depending on traffic, technician availability, and service location.
